missionSettings.description:
Team commander battle. Boscali holds North Boscali Airbase, Primeva holds Sandrift Airbase, and every other airbase on the map is neutral and capturable.

Each side starts with two vehicle depots, a radar, a few AA mounts and two dozers. There is no pre-placed army and no pre-placed industry: build your economy with the Ground Control (RTS) BUILD window, buy ground forces at your depots, and take the fight to the enemy.

Win by capturing the enemy home base.

Requires the Ground Control (RTS) mod on every player.

outcomes.Message: The enemy home base has fallen.
